findings.observation: The adult light-skinned face remains recognizably Raa through the soft rectangular jaw, broad cheeks, asymmetric brows, upturned nose, heavy lower lip, direct neutral gaze, and restrained adult age texture.
The sturdy-stocky source construction carries through in a broad compact torso, medium-height shape language, substantial legs, and grounded mass without an unrelated body-type shift.
Upper arms and forearms retain the source’s sturdy scale, wrists remain distinct, and both empty hands stay proportional to the stocky chibi rather than becoming oversized bodybuilder fists.
The matte blue-teal textured crop preserves the long swept side, close-shaved opposite side, parting, and asymmetric silhouette from the summon.

The terracotta-black tabard, offset closures, narrow cuffs, loose trousers, ankle wraps, geometric forearm tattoo, painted hem mark, pouch, and palette are preserved, but the wooden comb visible in the summon is absent rather than retained on the body.
Visual measurement places the complete hair-and-head unit at approximately one third of standing height, about 3.0 heads total and within the required 2.75–3.1 range.
Exactly one full-body subject is present; complete hair, both empty hands, split hem, both wrapped legs, and both feet remain inside safe margins.
Broad compact mass, asymmetrical hair, separated arms, clear tattoo, split tabard, and planted stance form a readable weaponless ready-idle silhouette at icon scale.

The render remains grounded and mortal with practical cloth and body markings; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, affinity cue, aura, glow, gem, floating, frame, star, UI, text, logo, or watermark appears.
